item.title: 'The View' hosts ask Rahm Emanuel if Trump started Iran war to distract from Epstein
item.summary: Iran war news dominates "The View" as Rahm Emanuel argues Trump made a "bad choice," warning the U.S. lacks a plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz if Iran does not comply.

item.title: NYC rideshare driver reportedly forced out of his own SUV at gunpoint after refusing four masked men rides
item.summary: A NYC rideshare driver was reportedly carjacked at gunpoint by four masked men in Lower Manhattan, and the stolen SUV was later recovered in Newark, N.J.

item.title: Police hunt armed suspect after housekeeper bound, attacked in luxury mansion heist: report
item.summary: An armed suspect allegedly tied up a housekeeper at a $20 million Beverly mansion, with homeowner Thomas Swan III calling the ordeal "horrendous."

item.title: Young brothers find human skull near creek; dozens more bones discovered in deadly mystery
item.summary: Two young brothers playing near a South Carolina creek discovered a human skull and roughly 45 bones, prompting a death investigation by authorities.

item.title: Super Bowl heading back to Las Vegas as NFL confirms 2029 site
item.summary: The NFL has officially awarded Las Vegas Super Bowl LXIII in 2029, with Allegiant Stadium set to host the big game for the second time in five years.

item.title: Trump signs executive order overhauling mail-in voting in major election integrity push
item.summary: Trump signed an executive order targeting mail-in voting and voter eligibility, directing agencies to compile citizenship lists and add USPS tracking.

item.title: Man charged in 'particularly heinous' killing of DC resident found bound and set on fire in ritzy area: police
item.summary: Rico Rashaad Barnes was arrested in the robbery-murder of Syed Hammad Hussain, whose D.C. apartment was allegedly ransacked and set ablaze after his death.

item.title: New ‘Supergirl’ star braces for backlash, believing women face scrutiny for 'simply existing' in franchises
item.summary: “Supergirl" star Milly Alcock said she fears backlash ahead of the film’s June premiere, arguing women in major franchises are often criticized for “simply existing."

item.title: Family ramps up search for missing coffee shop owner, mother of two, urges public to check cameras
item.summary: Amy Hillyard, 52, has been missing from Oakland since March 25. Authorities classified her as at-risk, and hundreds of volunteers are searching the East Bay.

item.title: Costco's $140, 10-pound Easter bunny has shoppers questioning price and instructions to smash it apart
item.summary: A giant 10-pound chocolate Easter bunny from Costco, priced up to $140, has sparked debate on social media over its price, quality and smash-to-eat instructions.
